title: Defining risk: threat, vulnerability and impact

videos.script: The shop's staff portal still has the password its installer came with. Is that a risk? {{portal}} Most people say yes straight away. The honest answer is: it depends on three things. {{three}} Something worth protecting, behind that login. Somebody or something that might try it. And the weakness itself, the password everybody can look up. {{chain}} Take away any one of them and the risk from that path goes away. Nobody can reach the portal? No threat. Nothing behind it? No impact. {{remove}} This lesson gives each piece its name: asset, threat, vulnerability, likelihood and impact. Lesson 3 uses them to decide what to fix first. {{next}}
